title: Fire-resistance ratings.
officialText: Exterior walls shall be fire-resistance rated in accordance with Tables 601, 602, and Appendix D where applicable. The fire-resistance rating of exterior walls with a fire-separation distance of greater than 10 feet (3048 mm) shall be rated for exposure to fire from the inside. The required fire-resistance rating of exterior walls with a fire separation distance of less than or equal to 10 feet (3048 mm) shall be rated for exposure to fire from both sides.
